PROP-57888860-inv-018.text: Each cell-proof pair from compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs must individually pass verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch.
PROP-57888860-inv-018.assertion: forall compute_cells_and_kzg_proofs(blob) -> (cells, proofs): verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch(commit(blob), range(CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB), cells, proofs) == true

PROP-57888860-inv-019.text: Recovered cells and proofs must be identical to originally computed cells and proofs for the same blob.

PROP-57888860-asm-001.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all cell data, proofs, and indices from peers must be fully validated.
PROP-57888860-asm-001.assertion: forall peer_message(cells, proofs, indices): validated(cells) AND validated(proofs) AND validated(indices) before use

PROP-57888860-asm-003.text: Engine API blob data is semi-trusted; blobs from EL must still pass KZG commitment verification.
PROP-57888860-asm-003.assertion: forall blob from EL: verify_blob_kzg_proof(blob, commitment) == true before propagation

PROP-57888860-inv-020.text: Domain separator in Fiat-Shamir must be RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN to prevent cross-protocol replay.
PROP-57888860-inv-020.assertion: forall compute_challenge: hash_input starts with RANDOM_CHALLENGE_KZG_CELL_BATCH_DOMAIN

PROP-57888860-inv-021.text: Forward coset FFT must shift-then-FFT; inverse must FFT-then-unshift (order is critical).
PROP-57888860-inv-021.assertion: forall coset_fft(vals, inv=False): result == fft(shift(vals, PRIMITIVE_ROOT)) AND coset_fft(vals, inv=True) == unshift(ifft(vals), PRIMITIVE_ROOT.inv())

PROP-57888860-inv-022.text: Vanishing polynomial coefficient spacing must be FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL for correct domain extension.
PROP-57888860-inv-022.assertion: forall construct_vanishing: zero_poly_coeff[i * FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL] == short_zero_poly[i] AND zero_poly_coeff[j] == 0 for j % FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL != 0

PROP-57888860-pre-005.text: At least one cell must be present for recovery; construct_vanishing_polynomial fails on all-missing input.
PROP-57888860-pre-005.assertion: forall recover(cell_indices): len(cell_indices) > 0 AND len(cell_indices) <= CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB

PROP-57888860-inv-023.text: Coset for each cell must contain exactly FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_CELL elements from bit-reversal permuted roots.

PROP-57888860-inv-024.text: Batch verification weight accumulation must correctly sum r_powers per unique commitment index.
PROP-57888860-inv-024.assertion: forall verify_batch: weights[commitment_indices[k]] == sum(r_powers[j] for j where commitment_indices[j] == commitment_indices[k])

PROP-57888860-inv-025.text: Validator custody requirement must be clamped between VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT and NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS.
PROP-57888860-inv-025.assertion: forall get_custody_req(indices) -> r: VALIDATOR_CUSTODY_REQUIREMENT <= r <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS

PROP-57888860-inv-026.text: Custody requirement calculation must use integer division of total balance by BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP.
PROP-57888860-inv-026.assertion: forall get_custody_req(indices): count == sum(effective_balance[i] for i in indices) // BALANCE_PER_ADDITIONAL_CUSTODY_GROUP

PROP-57888860-inv-027.text: Each blob must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cell-proof pairs in cells_and_kzg_proofs construction.

PROP-57888860-pre-006.text: Proof slicing indices in cells_and_kzg_proofs_construction must always be within blobs_bundle.proofs bounds.
PROP-57888860-pre-006.assertion: forall blob_i: start == i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB AND end == (i+1) * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB AND end <= len(blobs_bundle.proofs)

PROP-57888860-post-004.text: get_data_column_sidecars must produce exactly NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars.

PROP-57888860-inv-028.text: Each DataColumnSidecar.index must equal its positional column_index in the iteration.
PROP-57888860-inv-028.assertion: forall get_data_column_sidecars -> sidecars: sidecars[i].index == i for all i in range(NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS)

PROP-57888860-inv-029.text: Each sidecar must contain exactly one cell and one proof per blob in the block.
PROP-57888860-inv-029.assertion: forall sidecar in sidecars: len(sidecar.column) == len(kzg_commitments) AND len(sidecar.kzg_proofs) == len(kzg_commitments)

PROP-57888860-pre-007.text: cells_and_kzg_proofs length must equal kzg_commitments length before sidecar construction.

PROP-57888860-inv-030.text: Merkle inclusion proof must bind blob_kzg_commitments to the signed block header.

PROP-57888860-inv-031.text: Each sidecar must be published to exactly one deterministically computed subnet based on column_index.

PROP-57888860-inv-032.text: Sidecars must be retained for at least MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epochs.
PROP-57888860-inv-032.assertion: forall sidecar: current_epoch - sidecar_epoch <= MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_DATA_COLUMN_SIDECARS_REQUESTS => sidecar is stored AND served on request

PROP-57888860-inv-033.text: Optimized batch verification must produce the same accept/reject as individual cell KZG proof verification.
PROP-57888860-inv-033.assertion: forall cells, proofs, comms: verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch(comms, indices, cells, proofs) == AND(verify_cell_kzg_proof(comms[k], indices[k], cells[k], proofs[k]) for all k)

PROP-57888860-inv-034.text: Optimized FFT-based recovery must produce identical polynomial as naive Lagrange interpolation.
PROP-57888860-inv-034.assertion: forall available_cells: recover_polynomialcoeff(cells) == naive_interpolation(cells) for poly degree < FIELD_ELEMENTS_PER_BLOB

PROP-57888860-inv-039.text: Declared cell count per blob must equal actual cells produced by encoding.
PROP-57888860-inv-039.assertion: forall blob: declared_cells_per_blob == len(compute_cells(blob)) || raise InvalidBlob

PROP-57888860-inv-040.text: Precomputed setup values must be used directly; ad-hoc recomputation may introduce field errors.
PROP-57888860-inv-040.assertion: forall verify_op: setup.trusted_setup != None => use setup.trusted_setup, not recompute_setup()

PROP-57888860-inv-041.text: Dedup set must not skip proof verification for repeated commitments with new proofs.
PROP-57888860-inv-041.assertion: forall c in dedup(commitments): verify_kzg_proof(c, proof_new) must execute even if c was seen before

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-001.text: Deposit event data length must equal DEPOSIT_EVENT_LENGTH (576 bytes) or block is rejected.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-001.assertion: forall deposit_log: extract_deposit_data(log.data) => len(log.data) == DEPOSIT_EVENT_LENGTH || raises(InvalidBlock)

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-002.text: All five deposit field offsets must match expected constants or block is rejected.

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-003.text: All five deposit field sizes must match expected constants or block is rejected.

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-004.text: Extracted deposit data must be exactly 192 bytes: pubkey(48)+wc(32)+amount(8)+sig(96)+index(8).

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-005.text: Only logs from DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS are processed as deposit requests.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-005.assertion: forall log in processed_deposits: log.address == DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-006.text: Only logs with topics[0] == DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH are processed as deposits.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-006.assertion: forall log in processed_deposits: len(log.topics) > 0 && log.topics[0] == DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE_HASH

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-007.text: Deposit requests must be accumulated in receipt_keys order preserving on-chain deposit ordering.

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-008.text: Requests hash is computed over individually SHA-256 hashed requests in list order.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-008.assertion: compute_requests_hash(reqs) == sha256(concat(sha256(r).digest() for r in reqs)).digest()

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-009.text: Requests hash is order-dependent: changing request order must change the hash.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-009.assertion: forall reqs, perm(reqs): perm != reqs => compute_requests_hash(perm) != compute_requests_hash(reqs)

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-010.text: RLP encoding of account must follow strict order: (nonce, balance, storage_root, keccak256(code)).
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-010.assertion: forall acct: encode_account(acct) == rlp.encode((acct.nonce, acct.balance, storage_root, keccak256(acct.code)))

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-011.text: Authorization chain_id must match the target chain for replay protection.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-011.assertion: forall auth in tx.authorizations: auth.chain_id == current_chain_id || auth.chain_id == 0

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-012.text: Authorization (y_parity, r, s) must form a valid ECDSA signature over the authorization tuple.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-012.assertion: forall auth: ecrecover(auth.y_parity, auth.r, auth.s, hash(auth.chain_id, auth.address, auth.nonce)) != INVALID

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-013.text: Authorization nonce must match the current nonce of the authorizing account.

PROP-ff7df16a-pre-002.text: storage_root input to encode_account must be a 32-byte Merkle root of the account storage trie.

PROP-ff7df16a-pre-003.text: trie_get must return a non-None receipt for every key in receipt_keys during deposit parsing.
PROP-ff7df16a-pre-003.assertion: forall key in receipt_keys: trie_get(receipts_trie, key) != None

PROP-ff7df16a-post-001.text: Every deposit validation failure must terminate with an InvalidBlock exception.

PROP-ff7df16a-post-002.text: deposit_requests must accumulate all valid deposit data without gaps or omissions.

PROP-ff7df16a-post-003.text: Empty requests list must produce sha256 of empty input for requests hash.

PROP-ff7df16a-asm-001.text: P2P peers are untrusted: all block data including deposit logs must be fully validated.

PROP-ff7df16a-asm-002.text: Engine API communication is JWT-authenticated; EL data is semi-trusted but must be verified.

PROP-ff7df16a-asm-003.text: Deposit contract address is a trusted system constant; log filtering must use exact match.
PROP-ff7df16a-asm-003.assertion: DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS == constant && filter uses exact address comparison

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-018.text: An attacker must not forge deposit events from a non-deposit-contract address that pass validation.

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-019.text: Malformed deposit data with incorrect offsets must not bypass validation and corrupt deposit requests.

PROP-ff7df16a-inv-020.text: EIP-7702 authorization must not be replayable across different chains.
PROP-ff7df16a-inv-020.assertion: forall auth, chain1, chain2: chain1 != chain2 => !valid_on(auth, chain2) if valid_on(auth, chain1) && auth.chain_id != 0
